dominant_strengths: Strong headline typography with confident scale and tight tracking anchors the dark hero with editorial gravity.
Charming illustrated agent mascots paired with app icons create a memorable, narrative-driven brand moment around AI agents.
Cohesive midnight-blue palette with subtle spotlight gradient guides attention to CTA and product screenshot.
dominant_weaknesses: Product screenshot is generic light-mode UI on a dark stage—jarring contrast break that fights the night-shift metaphor.
Logo bar at the bottom feels cramped and visually disconnected from the dramatic hero, weakening composition flow.
Decorative orbiting icons risk visual noise; spacing around mascots is uneven and competes with the headline focus.
fix_priorities: Reframe the product screenshot in a dark-mode variant or tinted device frame to preserve the nocturnal mood.
Tighten orbital icon composition with clearer rhythm/spacing so mascots support rather than crowd the headline.
Increase breathing room above the logo strip and unify its treatment with the hero's tonal gradient.
rationale.norman_balance: Visceral leads via theatrical dark hero and mascots, behavioral is solid but the bright screenshot disrupts flow, reflective payoff lands through the 'night shift' metaphor.
rationale.intent_fit: Yes—clearly positions Notion's AI agents as always-on collaborators with on-brand whimsy and strong marketing hierarchy.
